> <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Home Purchase Loan (primary market)</span>

> <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">These terms have been previously known as Retail Lending Terms and Conditions under code 11RBD PL 72-03-01. Some of the Bank documents may contain references to these terms and conditions under the former name and code.</span>

> <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Depending on the creditworthiness of the borrower, term of loan and LTV ratio, a higher or lower interest rate can be applied.</span>

> <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The annual percentage rate (APR) may differ from the above specified values if there is any or a few of the following factors:<br>- When the property insurance is obtained by the Bank at the customer’s request<br>- When the borrower selects differentiated or mixed form of loan repayment<br>- If there are deviations from the creditworthiness criteria approved under the internal regulations of the Bank<br>- If additional property is pledged as collateral<br>- If there are other deviations</span>

> <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Attention! The adjustable nominal interest rate may be revised no more than twice a year. Furthermore, depending on the change of the adjustable nominal interest rate, the threshold above or below which the nominal rate cannot change is ±5%.</span>

> <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The list of developers is determined by the Bank. If the developer is not included in the Bank&#x27;s list, the terms of the loans for purchase of residential real estate from secondary market will apply.</span>

| <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">10. Provision of loan before submitting to the Bank the document certifying state registration of the security interest</span> | <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">AMD 25,000 (per issue)</span> |
| <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">11. Issuing other consent not established by this document and not related to the collateral</span> | <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">AMD 10,000<br>(VAT included)</span> |
| <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">12. Revision/modification of another loan term not specified in this document (including interest rate revision)</span> | <span style="background:#e6ffed;color:#116329;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">0.1% of the outstanding loan amount, minimum AMD 10,000</span> |

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The real estate should be appraised by an appraisal company cooperating with the bank. The company is selected by the client from the offered list. Appraisal fee: AMD 13,000-30,000 depending on the property. On a case-by-case basis, the fee for appraisal of major items of property may be negotiable. The list of appraisal companies cooperating with the Bank may be found at the link below.</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Appraisal Companies Cooperating with Ameriabank</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Insurance for the pledged property to be obtained on an annual basis throughout the loan term:</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">by the bank to the extent of outstanding loan</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">by the client at least to the extent of outstanding loan</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Notary fee: AMD 14,000-16,000 lump-sum (in case of vehicles)</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Notary fee: AMD 13,000-18,000 lump-sum (in case of real estate)</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Fee for unified statement from the State Real Estate Cadaster on encumbrance of the property: AMD 10,000</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Fee for registration of security interest in the real estate: AMD 26,000</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Certificate of the right to purchase real estate and registration of the security interest: AMD 3,000 and AMD 50,000</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Certificate of acquisition of the title to the real estate and registration of the security interest: AMD 21,000 and AMD 50,000</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Certificate of acquisition of the title to the commercial real estate and registration of the security interest: AMD 41,000 (if the area of the premises to be purchased and pledged is above 200 sq. m) and AMD 50,000</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Fee of the Police of the Republic of Armenia (for lien and pledge of movable property): AMD 5,000 lump sum</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Depending on various circumstances, the bank may request other documents and information. Where required under the Republic of Armenia Law “On Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing”, we may request you to provide additional information and documents to conduct “Know your customer” check, as well as ask further questions during verbal communication.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">INFORMATION ON FACTORS ABOUT CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">This document sets out the information required under the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations about the credit history and the credit score of customers during lending in Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter “the Bank”) and the factors affecting them.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Credit History is the information on the customer’s financial obligations generated/processed by the Credit Bureau, which shows the customer’s debt, payments, payment habits or other data related to the customer’s obligations or their performance and the dynamics/history of such information.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The credit history includes, in particular, the information required for customer identification, amount of each monetary obligation of the customer, annual interest rate, outstanding liabilities, order and terms of payments, payment delays, guarantees issued to the third parties, information about the liabilities of the parties affiliated with the customer (in depersonalized form) and the information about credit history inquiries.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">As a rule, financial organizations use the credit history to assess the customer’s monetary (credit) obligations, guarantees issued to the third parties, to consider the possibilities of lending at the customer’s or bank’s initiative and to submit lending offers to the customer.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Based on the customer’s consent the Bank sends an inquiry to ACRA Credit Bureau. The information about the credit history is reflected in the credit report which covers the customer’s credit history for the most recent 5 years.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The Customer’s credit history is available at http://www.acra.am/.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Credit score is the quantified measure of the customer’s borrowing capacity and creditworthiness.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The Bank uses its own system to assess the borrowing capacity and creditworthiness for lending to customers. The factors affecting it are as follows:</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Credit history. The quantity and amount of existing loans, frequency of applying for loans, positive credit history (no payment delays in the credit history, high quality of loan service) can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending, while a bad credit history (payment delays in the credit history, persistent nature of such delays) can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score, rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Employment, income and work experience. Stable job and income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending. Unstable or non-permanent job or income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Credit burden.High credit burden and its big share in the income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms, while a low credit burden and its small share in the income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">FICO Score. FICO Score is a scoring system that provides a numerical value of credit risk through statistic research and analysis of the customer’s credit history. It is a key used by lenders worldwide to assess creditworthiness and financial risks. Details are available at acra.am.</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Other information about the Customer</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The importance of credit history and credit score</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Credit history and credit score are essential for making a decision on lending, enabling banks and credit organizations to assess the credit risk of the customer during lending and predict the customer’s proper fulfillment of customer’s monetary obligations and its likelihood.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Wrong or incomplete credit history</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">If there are wrong or incomplete data in the credit history, the customer can apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or directly to the financial organizations having provided the information to the Credit Bureau to correct or clarify such data.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The procedure and details on applying to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC is available at www.acra.am</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Where wrong or incomplete information has been provided to the Credit Bureau by the Bank, the customer can apply to the Bank via any of the following channels:</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">By sending an application to the Bank’s official email address</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111 phone numbers</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">By sending a message via the Bank’s Online/Mobile Banking system</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">By submitting an application at any of the Bank’s branches.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The Bank will process the customer’s application in the manner and within the time frames defined by the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations, and/or the Bank’s internal regulations.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">How to improve the credit history and credit score</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">To improve the credit history and credit score it is necessary to eliminate its root causes as soon as possible, in particular:</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Make loan payments in accordance with the defined schedule, excluding any late payments and even 1-day overdue liabilities</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Limit the number and amount of provided guarantees, by repaying the overdue liabilities secured by guarantees, if possible</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Reduce the credit burden by repaying the outstanding liabilities</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Avoid submitting new loan applications frequently since credit history inquiries (other than for loan monitoring purposes) may negatively affect the customer’s Credit Score.</span>

| <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">ք. Երեւան, Քանաքեռ-Զեյթուն Պ. Սեւակի փողոց 51/2 շենք</span> |
| <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">ք. Երեւան, Արաբկիր Մամիկոնյանց փողոց 45/1 շենք</span> |
| <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">ք.Երեւան, Աջափնյակ Նորաշեն թաղամաս 47/5 շենք</span> |

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">- When the borrower selects differentiated or mixed form of loan repayment</span>

## <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">SERVICE FEES FOR LOANS TO INDIVIDUALS</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Approved by Management Board resolution # 01/68/18 dated May 14, 2018.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Current edition approved by resolution # .... dated ... , effective from July 14, 2026.</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">General Provisions</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1. Under this document, “loan” means the loan types envisaged by the Retail Lending Terms and Conditions of the Bank.</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2. The changes specified in this document are made based on the client’s application, subject to its approval in accordance with the Bank’s internal regulations.</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3. These fees apply to changes initiated by the client. The changes made in order to ensure the client’s performance of the condition subsequent established by the Bank are not considered as the client’s initiative.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">11RBD PL 72-03-29, Ed. 3</span>

- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4. The fees specified in this document do not apply to the automatically approved consumer loans secured by deposit, bonds and metal accounts in gold.</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5. Where several fees are applicable due to change of several terms of the same loan as per the application submitted by the client, only the highest of them shall be charged, once.</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">6. To apply a fee(s) established by this document for modification of the same term for several loans, the total outstanding amount of those loans is considered.</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">7. The fee amount is rounded to AMD 1,000 in favor of the client and shall be no less than the minimum amount of the respective fee (if established by this document).</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">8. Where a new collateral or guarantor is added due to modification of a loan term(s), no fee is charged.</span>
- <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">9. In case of lines of credit and overdrafts, the outstanding loan amount means the bigger of the used amount of the line of credit/overdraft and the line of credit/overdraft limit currently available to the client.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">11RBD PL 72-03-29, Ed. 3</span>

| --- | --- |
| <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1. Term extension for mortgage/investment loans</span> | <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">0.1% of the outstanding loan amount, minimum AMD 50,000</span> |

## On the Procedure for Setting, Calculation and Revision of the Floating (Adjustable) Interest Rate

## <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">AGREEMENT # --- ON ADJUSTABLE INTEREST RATE SETTING AND CALCULATION</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">This agreement (hereinafter the “Agreement”) is entered into on [date] in Yerevan under the laws and regulations of Armenia by and between Ameriabank Closed Joint Stock Company (incorporated under the resolution of the CBA Board dated September 8, 1992, registration number 50, certificate No 0154; address: 2 V. Sargsyan, Yerevan) hereinafter the “Bank”, represented by the authorized person acting on behalf of the Bank, and ................. hereinafter the “Client” or the “Borrower”. The Bank and the Client shall be hereinafter jointly referred to as the “Parties” and individually as the “Party”. This Agreement on Adjustable Interest Rate Setting and Calculation forms an integral part of Agreement # [--] (hereinafter referred to as the “Principal Agreement”).</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1 SUBJECT OF THE AGREEMENT</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1.1. The Parties hereby define the procedure for regular revision of the loan interest rate under the Principal Agreement in response to the changes in market interest rates to ensure that the interest rate determined by the Parties is consistent with the market rates to the highest possible degree at all times subject to the procedure established hereby.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1.2. The Agreement forms an integral part of the Principal Agreement.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1.3. Hereby the Parties agree that the interest rate set by the Principal Agreement shall be considered adjustable and variable (hereinafter “Adjustable Rate”) as stipulated under this Agreement.</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2 ADJUSTABLE INTEREST RATE CONSTITUENTS</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.1. The Adjustable Rate defined by the Principal Agreement shall consist of the following constituents (components):</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.1.1. Base Rate</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.1.2. Margin (fixed component)</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.2. The Adjustable Rate is a nominal interest rate calculated in accordance with this Agreement using the following formula: RA = RB + RM where RA is the Adjustable Rate, RB is the Base Rate and RM is the Margin (fixed component).</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">One primary index (hereinafter “Primary Rate” and/or “Primary Index”) and one secondary index (hereinafter “Secondary Rate” and/or “Secondary Index”) of Base Rate shall be used as basis for calculation and adjusting of the Adjustable Rate, which cannot be changed during the term of the Agreement, except in cases defined in chapter 5. The Secondary Index shall be applied if the Primary Index is inaccessible and setting of the Adjustable Rate for the next period becomes impossible.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.3. The Base Rate shall be determined on the basis of the following market rates, depending on the loan currency:</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.3.1. In case of Adjustable Rates for AMD-denominated loans: the primary rate underlying the Base Rate shall be the yield to maturity of Armenian 6-month Government (treasury) bills. Secondary Rate is the average yield of Armenian 6-month (or if not available, closest to 6 months) Government (treasury) bills in primary auction.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.3.2. In case of Adjustable Rates for USD-denominated loans: the primary rate underlying the Base Rate shall be the CME Term SOFR USD 6 Month reference rate. The Secondary Rate shall be the value of 6-month US treasury bills yield curve.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.3.3. In case of Adjustable Rates for EUR-denominated loans: the primary rate underlying the Base Rate shall be the EURIBOR 6 Month rate. The Secondary Index shall be the value of the Germany 6 Month Government EUR Bond yield curve.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.4. Where it is necessary to choose a Secondary Rate, in order to avoid significant fluctuations between interest rates calculated based on Primary and Secondary Rates and prevent either Party from acquiring unjustified economic gain or incurring loss at the expense of the other Party, calculation of interest rate based on Secondary Rate shall include an adjusting factor to balance possible differences between rates (hereinafter “Spread Adjustment&quot;). Spread Adjustment shall be calculated by the Bank and presented to the Borrower with its amount indicated in the selection Offer. During calculation of the Adjustable Rate throughout the term of the Agreement after selection of the Secondary Rate, the Spread Adjustment shall remain unchanged and be included in calculation of interest</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">rate at all times, and accordingly, calculation of the Adjustable Rate based on Secondary Rate shall be performed using the following formula:</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">RA = RB + SA + RM</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">where</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">RA is the Adjustable Rate</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">RB is the Base Rate</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">SA is the Spread Adjustment</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">RM is the margin (fixed component)</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">However, regardless of application of the Spread Adjustment, if the Agreement provides for a maximum Adjustable Rate limit, the interest rate calculated on the basis of the Secondary Rate and Spread Adjustment shall not exceed the set maximum limit1.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.5. The margin (fixed component) shall be determined based on the terms of lending and shall be fixed in the loan agreement for each loan separately, on the basis of the respective loan decision adopted by the authorized body of the Bank.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2.6. For the purpose of this Agreement and the Principal Agreement, the base rate of the Adjustable Rate for the Client (Borrower) at the time of execution of the Principal Agreement shall be equal to _______ percent, while the Margin (fixed component) shall be equal to _______ percent. Where the base rate of the Adjustable Rate is a negative value, the Adjustable Rate under the Principal Agreement shall be calculated based on 0 (zero).</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3 POSTING, UPDATING AND COMMUNICATING INFORMATION ON THE BASE RATE</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.1. Information on the yield to maturity of Armenian Government (treasury) bills can be obtained from the relevant publications (yield curve) on the official website of the CBA at the following link:</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">https://www.cba.am/am/SitePages/fmofinancialmarkets.aspx</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">Information on the average yield of Armenian 6-month (or if not available, closest to 6 months) Government (treasury) bills in primary auctions can be retrieved from the official website of the Armenian Securities Exchange at the following link:</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">https://amx.am/am/government_bond_auctions</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.2. Information on the CME Term SOFR USD 6 Month reference rate can be retrieved from Bloomberg terminal under TSFR6M ticker (SR6M in Reuters).</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.3. Information on the EURIBOR 6 Month rate can be retrieved from Bloomberg terminal under EUR006M ticker (EURIBOR6MD in Reuters).</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.4. Information on the yield of 6-month US treasury bills can be retrieved from Bloomberg terminal under H15T6M ticker (US6MT=RR in Reuters).</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.5. Information on the yield curve of Germany 6 Month Government EUR Bonds can be retrieved from Bloomberg terminal under YCGT0016 ticker (DE6MT=RR in Reuters).</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.6. In case of inaccessibility of the Bloomberg Terminal or impossibility to check the information for any other reason, the Bank shall, upon the Borrower’s request, provide the information retrieved from the system to the Borrower by e-mail or other e-channels acceptable to the Parties and/or deliver it to the Borrower within the Bank premises. Whenever Bloomberg Terminal is not accessible, the information retrieved from Thomson Reuters Eikon shall be used as an alternative.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">1 This clause is not applicable in case of mortgage and consumer loans.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.7. Change of any link specified in clauses 3.1, 3.2., 3.3, 3.4 ,3.5 and 3.9. above shall not affect or have any implications for this Agreement and/or its validity, except for the special cases provided for in clause 5.1 below.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.8. The Base Rate shall be revised on February 1 and August 1 each year. In particular:</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.8.1.On February 1, the Base Rate shall be equal to the respective interest rate on the 30th business day preceding February 1 of that year. Where the value is negative, calculation is based on 0.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.8.2.On August 1, the Base Rate shall be equal to the respective interest rate on the 30th business day preceding August 1. Where the value is negative, calculation is based on 0.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.8.3.The method of calculation of the Base Rate specified in clause 3.8 herein cannot change during the term of the Agreement and the Principal Agreement.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3.9. The revised Base Rate and information about its changes shall be published on the Bank’s official website twice a year, on the first business days of February and August.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">https://ameriabank.am/business/sme/financing/support/base-rate</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4 THE PROCEDURE OF REGULAR REVIEW AND REVISION OF THE ADJUSTABLE INTEREST RATE</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.1. The first revision of the Adjustable Rate in accordance with this Agreement shall be in 3 (three)2 years after execution of the Principal Agreement, except in the case defined under clause 5.1 herein, unless otherwise provided for by the imperative norms of the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations. Thereafter, the Adjustable Rate may be revised regularly every 6 (six) months. Prior to the date of the first revision, the Base Rate shall be deemed equal to the Base Rate effective on the date of execution of the Principal Agreement.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.2. The Base Rate effective on the date of revision shall be deemed the applicable rate for the time span between the given and next revisions. Loan interest payments shall be calculated and made at the revised interest rate.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.3. The date of application (calculation) of changed interest rate shall be the first payment date following the base rate change date (the first day of February and August).</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.4. Calculations of the Base Rate shall be performed by rounding the rate to the nearest multiple of 0.5 (zero point five) percent. E.g., 8.23% shall be rounded to 8.0%, 8.25% shall be rounded to 8.5%, and 8.41% shall be rounded to 8.5%.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.5. Hereby the Parties agree that the Base Rate:</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.5.1 Shall be revised by the Bank, if the difference between the interest rate for any particular period (rounded to 0.5 p.p.) and the effective Base Rate is more than 1%. The rate can be revised not more than to the extent of such difference, however, the Bank at its own discretion can revise the rate to a smaller extent which in any case should not be lower than 0.5%. (E.g., if the effective Base Rate is 8% and the new rate is 9.5%, the Bank can revise the rate by 0.5%, 1% or 1.5%).</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.5.2 Can be revised at the Bank’s discretion, if the difference between the interest rate for any particular period (rounded to 0.5 p.p.) and the effective Base Rate does not exceed 1%.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The terms of revision of the Base Rate set out in this clause shall be applicable both to upward and downward revision of the rate.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.6. The revised rate shall be applied to the outstanding loan not earlier than 7 (seven) business days after giving notice to the Borrower in the manner of notification/communication specified in the Principal Agreement.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">The Parties hereby state that in any case the loan interest rate specified in the Principal Agreement shall not exceed --- percent and shall not be less than ---- percent.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">4.7. The maximum increase threshold of the loan rate under the Principal Agreement shall not exceed the maximum decrease threshold.3</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">2 The 3-year requirement is mandatory in case of mortgage loans only.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">3This clause is effective and applicable in case of mortgage and consumer loans only.</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5 EXCEPTIONAL CIRCUMSTANCES</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1. Where the Primary and Secondary Indicators become inaccessible and impossible, the Parties agree that the Bank shall offer another similar indicator for the next period, relying solely on the standards defined by the CBA or the legislation of the Republic of Armenia. Adjustable Rate shall be considered inaccessible and impossible under the following exceptional circumstances.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1.1. Procedure of market interest rate calculation undergoes material changes.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1.2. Information on the interest rate, specified in clauses 2.3.1, 2.3.2 or 2.3.3, is no longer published for respective currency.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1.3. In the reasonable opinion of the Bank’s authorized body the given interest rate no longer represents the actual market situation.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1.4. Certain amendments to the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations prohibit or make it impossible to change the interest rate in accordance with the provisions of the Principal Agreement and the Agreement.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1.5. There are other economically or legally reasonable and justifiable bases.</span>  
<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.1.6. In other cases provided for under the laws and regulations of the Republic of Armenia.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">5.2. Hereby the Borrower agrees that the Bank shall have the right to revise and adjust the Loan interest rate in favor of the Borrower at any time and any intervals during the term of the Agreement and/or the Principal Agreement.</span>

### <span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">6 MISCELLANEOUS</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">6.1. This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Parties’ successors and assigns.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">6.2. The Agreement is made in Armenian and English in the number of counterparts equal to that of the Parties and persons providing security for obligations (if any). All counterparts are legally equal. Each Party receives one counterpart. By signing the Agreement each of the Parties confirms the receipt of their counterpart. In case of discrepancies the Armenian version shall prevail.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">6.3. Disagreements and disputes arising out of or in connection with the Agreement shall be referred to and resolved by the court of general jurisdiction of Yerevan, unless otherwise agreed between the Parties and/or stipulated by imperative legal norms of the Republic of Armenia.</span>

<span style="background:#fff4e5;color:#b54708;padding:0.08em 0.18em;">6.4. The Agreement shall become effective upon signing by both Parties and shall remain in full force and effect until proper fulfillment of the liabilities of the Parties under the Agreement.</span>

For foreign currency loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 70%² of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer’s⁵ reference provided to the client,<br>For foreign currency loans with a term above 240 months: up to 60%² of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer’s⁵ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,<br>3. up to 100% of the value of cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank.<br>4. In case of loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 60%² of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer’s⁵ reference provided to the client</del></span> |

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>    /* loan calculator */</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>    $(document).ready(function() {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>        setTimeout(function () {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>            function mortgageCalculator() {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                const mainElement = $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt&quot;); </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                if(mainElement.length) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    function calculateLoanPayment(loanAmount, interestRate, maturityMounths) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const monthlyRate = (interestRate / 100) / 12;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const payment = (loanAmount * monthlyRate) / (1 - Math.pow((1 + monthlyRate), -maturityMounths));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const mounthlyPayment = parseInt(payment);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const totalAmount = parseInt(payment * maturityMounths);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const interestAmount = parseInt(totalAmount - loanAmount);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const moneyFormatter  = new Intl.NumberFormat();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__mounthly-payment&quot;).text(moneyFormatter.format(mounthlyPayment));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__total-amount&quot;).text(moneyFormatter.format(totalAmount));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__interest-amount&quot;).text(moneyFormatter.format(interestAmount));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const rangeRate = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__rate-range&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const numberRate = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__rate-number&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const rangeAmount = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__amount-range&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const numberAmount = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__amount-number&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const rangeMounths = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__mounths-range&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const numberMounths = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__mounths-number&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    validateMinMax(rangeRate, numberRate, 12.5, 14);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    validateMinMaxAmount(rangeAmount, numberAmount, 3000000, 150000000);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    validateMinMax(rangeMounths, numberMounths, 60, 360);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    calculateLoanPayment(numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;), numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    function validateMinMaxAmount(rangeField, numberField, minValue, maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.value=numberField.value==&#x27;&#x27;?&#x27;&#x27;:(+numberField.value).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        rangeField.addEventListener(&#x27;input&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value=numberField.value==&#x27;&#x27;?&#x27;&#x27;:(+e.target.value).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            let numberAmountConverted = numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            calculateLoanPayment(numberAmountConverted, numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.addEventListener(&quot;focus&quot;, function(e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            this.value = this.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            this.type=&#x27;number&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.addEventListener(&#x27;focusout&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = (+minValue).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = (+maxValue).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.value=this.value==&#x27;&#x27;?&#x27;&#x27;:(+this.value).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = this.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            let numberAmountConverted = numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            calculateLoanPayment(numberAmountConverted, numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    function validateMinMax(rangeField, numberField, minValue, maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        rangeField.addEventListener(&#x27;input&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = e.target.value;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            let numberAmountConverted = numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            calculateLoanPayment(numberAmountConverted, numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.addEventListener(&#x27;focusout&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            let numberAmountConverted = numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            calculateLoanPayment(numberAmountConverted, numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>            }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>        </del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/div&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;script&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>    /* loan calculator */</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>    $(document).ready(function() {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>        setTimeout(function () {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>            function mortgageCalculator() {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                const mainElement = $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt&quot;); </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                if(mainElement.length) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    function calculateLoanPayment(loanAmount, interestRate, maturityMounths) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const monthlyRate = (interestRate / 100) / 12;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const payment = (loanAmount * monthlyRate) / (1 - Math.pow((1 + monthlyRate), -maturityMounths));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const mounthlyPayment = parseInt(payment);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const totalAmount = parseInt(payment * maturityMounths);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const interestAmount = parseInt(totalAmount - loanAmount);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        const moneyFormatter  = new Intl.NumberFormat();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__mounthly-payment&quot;).text(moneyFormatter.format(mounthlyPayment));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__total-amount&quot;).text(moneyFormatter.format(totalAmount));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        $(&quot;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__interest-amount&quot;).text(moneyFormatter.format(interestAmount));</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const rangeRate = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__rate-range&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const numberRate = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__rate-number&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const rangeAmount = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__amount-range&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const numberAmount = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__amount-number&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const rangeMounths = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__mounths-range&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    const numberMounths = document.querySelector(&#x27;#loan-calculator__mrt .loan-calculator__mounths-number&#x27;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    validateMinMax(rangeRate, numberRate, 12.5, 14);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    validateMinMaxAmount(rangeAmount, numberAmount, 3000000, 150000000);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    validateMinMax(rangeMounths, numberMounths, 60, 360);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    calculateLoanPayment(numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;), numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    function validateMinMaxAmount(rangeField, numberField, minValue, maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.value=numberField.value==&#x27;&#x27;?&#x27;&#x27;:(+numberField.value).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        rangeField.addEventListener(&#x27;input&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value=numberField.value==&#x27;&#x27;?&#x27;&#x27;:(+e.target.value).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            let numberAmountConverted = numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            calculateLoanPayment(numberAmountConverted, numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.addEventListener(&quot;focus&quot;, function(e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            this.value = this.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            this.type=&#x27;number&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        numberField.addEventListener(&#x27;focusout&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = (+minValue).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = (+maxValue).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.type=&#x27;&#x27;; </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                this.value=this.value==&#x27;&#x27;?&#x27;&#x27;:(+this.value).toLocaleString();</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = this.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del></del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            let numberAmountConverted = numberAmount.value.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).join(&quot;&quot;);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            calculateLoanPayment(numberAmountConverted, numberRate.value, numberMounths.value);</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        });</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    }</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                </del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                    function validateMinMax(rangeField, numberField, minValue, maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                        rangeField.addEventListener(&#x27;input&#x27;, function (e) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            if (e.target.value &lt; minValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = minValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else if (e.target.value &gt; maxValue) {</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                rangeField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                                numberField.value = maxValue;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>                            } else {</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5. Security&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5.1. Eligible collateral&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; 1. The loan is secured by the real estate being purchased. The Bank may consider pledge of other real estate as additional security to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank, as well as cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 2. If the borrower wishes to purchase property under construction without registered certificate of title, the loan will be secured by other Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 3. If the borrower wishes to purchase property abroad, the loan will be secured by Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. In the case of online refinancing, the collateral is real estate purchased directly from the developer, which has a completion certificate and is not encumbered with any liabilities other than the refinanced loan.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;tr&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5.2. Loan-to-value (LTV) ratio&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; rowspan=&quot;2&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5.2.1. The loan is issued:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;1. For AMD loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 90%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For AMD loans with a term above 240 months: up to 80%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁶ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 2. For foreign currency loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 70%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For foreign currency loans with a term above 240 months: up to 60%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 3. up to 100% of the value of cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. For up to AMD 30 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 70% (if in Yerevan) and up to 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 30-50 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 60% (if in Yerevan) and up to 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 50-100 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 50% (if in Yerevan) and up to 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;8.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; At any time during a contractual year the borrower can make an early repayment to the extent of outstanding principal amount of loan for that contractual year. A contractual year is each period of 12 months following the date of execution of credit agreement.&lt;br /&gt; Where the amount of early repayment exceeds the specified limit, the following fees will be charged:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.6% of early repayment, if made during the first year of the agreement&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.4% of early repayment, if made during the second year of the agreement&lt;br /&gt; &amp;bull; Max 0.2% of early repayment, if made during the third year of the agreement&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td width=&quot;305&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;11.1 Without creditworthiness assessment&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: line-through;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;Where the loan amount is AMD 50-100 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 50% (if in Yerevan) or 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is AMD 30-50 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 40% (if in Yerevan) or 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is up to AMD 30 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 30% (if in Yerevan) or 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;sup&gt;1&lt;/sup&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;These terms have been previously known as Retail Lending Terms and Conditions under code 11RBD PL 72-03-01. Some of the Bank documents may contain references to these terms and conditions under the former name and code.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;sup2;Depending on the creditworthiness of the borrower, term of loan and LTV ratio, a higher or lower interest rate can be applied.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td width=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/tr&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;tr&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td colspan=&quot;5&quot; width=&quot;1255&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&amp;sup3;The annual percentage rate (APR) may differ from the above specified values if there is any or a few of the following factors:&lt;br /&gt; - When the property insurance is obtained by the Bank at the customer&amp;rsquo;s request &lt;br /&gt; - When the borrower selects differentiated or mixed form of loan repayment&lt;br /&gt; - If there are deviations from the creditworthiness criteria approved under the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; - If additional property is pledged as collateral&lt;br /&gt; - If there are other deviations&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td width=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;tr&gt;</del></span>
