<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5.1.1.&lt;br /&gt; 1. The loan is secured by the real estate being purchased. The Bank may consider pledge of other real estate as additional security to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank, as well as cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 2. If the borrower wishes to purchase property under construction without registered certificate of title, the loan will be secured by other Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank. &lt;br /&gt; 3. If the borrower wishes to purchase property abroad, the loan will be secured by Armenia-based real estate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. In the case of online refinancing, the collateral is real estate purchased directly from the developer, which has a completion certificate and is not encumbered with any liabilities other than the refinanced loan.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;5.2.1. The loan is issued:&lt;br /&gt; &amp;nbsp;1. For AMD loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 90%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For AMD loans with a term above 240 months: up to 80%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁶ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 2. For foreign currency loans with a term of 61-240 months: up to 70%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client,&lt;br /&gt; For foreign currency loans with a term above 240 months: up to 60%&amp;sup2; of the (i) lesser of the two: appraised market value of the property and purchase price, or (ii) value specified in the developer&amp;rsquo;s⁵ reference provided to the client, unless otherwise determined by the Bank,&lt;br /&gt; 3. up to 100% of the value of cash in the Bank or bonds issued by the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; 4. For up to AMD 30 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 70% (if in Yerevan) and up to 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 30-50 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 60% (if in Yerevan) and up to 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;br /&gt; For AMD 50-100 million loans without creditworthiness assessment: up to 50% (if in Yerevan) and up to 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) of the price specified in the developer reference⁵ or the lower of the two: appraised market value or purchase price of pledged property (this clause does not refer to the loans issued with a purpose of transfer of existing loans from another bank/credit organization).&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;td colspan=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;888&quot;&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: line-through;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;Where the loan amount is AMD 50-100 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 50% (if in Yerevan) or 60% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is AMD 30-50 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 40% (if in Yerevan) or 50% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;br /&gt; &lt;br /&gt; Where the loan amount is up to AMD 30 million, the loan may be issued without the assessment of creditworthiness criteria if the customer (including non-resident) has made a down payment of 30% (if in Yerevan) or 40% (if in the regions of Armenia) and more and meets the requirements of the internal regulations of the Bank.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>

Where required under the Republic of Armenia Law “On Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing”, we may request you to provide additional information and documents to conduct “Know your customer” check, as well as ask further questions during verbal communication.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>h3</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&quot;&quot;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&quot;&quot;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&quot;&quot;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;INFORMATION ON FACTORS ABOUT CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;This document sets out the information required under the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations about the credit history and the credit score of customers during lending in Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter “the Bank”) and the factors affecting them.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit History&lt;/strong&gt; is the information on the customer’s financial obligations generated/processed by the Credit Bureau, which shows the customer’s debt, payments, payment habits or other data related to the customer’s obligations or their performance and the dynamics/history of such information.&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The credit history includes, in particular, the information required for customer identification, amount of each monetary obligation of the customer, annual interest rate, outstanding liabilities, order and terms of payments, payment delays, guarantees issued to the third parties, information about the liabilities of the parties affiliated with the customer (in depersonalized form) and the information about credit history inquiries.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;As a rule, financial organizations use the credit history to assess the customer’s monetary (credit) obligations, guarantees issued to the third parties, to consider the possibilities of lending at the customer’s or bank’s initiative and to submit lending offers to the customer.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Based on the customer’s consent the Bank sends an inquiry to ACRA Credit Bureau. The information about the credit history is reflected in the credit report which covers the customer’s credit history for the most recent 5 years.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The Customer’s credit history is available at &lt;a href=&quot;http://www.acra.am/&quot;&gt;http://www.acra.am/&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit score&lt;/strong&gt; is the quantified measure of the customer’s borrowing capacity and creditworthiness.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The Bank uses its own system to assess the borrowing capacity and creditworthiness for lending to customers. The factors affecting it are as follows:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit history&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;․ &lt;/strong&gt;The quantity and amount of existing loans, frequency of applying for loans, positive credit history (no payment delays in the credit history, high quality of loan service) can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending, while a bad credit history (payment delays in the credit history, persistent nature of such delays) can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score, rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Employment, income and work experience&lt;/strong&gt;. Stable job and income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending. Unstable or non-permanent job or income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit burden.&lt;/strong&gt;High credit burden and its big share in the income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms, while a low credit burden and its small share in the income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;FICO Score. FICO Score&lt;/strong&gt; is a scoring system that provides a numerical value of credit risk through statistic research and analysis of the customer’s credit history. It is a key used by lenders worldwide to assess creditworthiness and financial risks. Details are available at &lt;a href=&quot;https://acra.am/սքոր/&quot;&gt;acra.am&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Other information about the Customer &lt;/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The importance of credit history and credit score&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Credit history and credit score are essential for making a decision on lending, enabling banks and credit organizations to assess the credit risk of the customer during lending and predict the customer’s proper fulfillment of customer’s monetary obligations and its likelihood.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wrong or incomplete credit history &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;If there are wrong or incomplete data in the credit history, the customer can apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or directly to the financial organizations having provided the information to the Credit Bureau to correct or clarify such data.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The procedure and details on applying to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC is available at www.&lt;a href=&quot;https://acra.am/կապ-և-աջակցություն/հաճախորդի-իրավունքներ/&quot;&gt;acra.am&lt;/a&gt; &amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Where wrong or incomplete information has been provided to the Credit Bureau by the Bank, the customer can apply to the Bank via any of the following channels:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By sending an application to the Bank’s official email address&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111 phone numbers&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By sending a message via the Bank’s Online/Mobile Banking system&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By submitting an application at any of the Bank’s branches.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The Bank will process the customer’s application in the manner and within the time frames defined by the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations, and/or the Bank’s internal regulations.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How to improve the credit history and credit score&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;To improve the credit history and credit score it is necessary to eliminate its root causes as soon as possible, in particular:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Make loan payments in accordance with the defined schedule, excluding any late payments and even 1-day overdue liabilities&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Limit the number and amount of provided guarantees, by repaying the overdue liabilities secured by guarantees, if possible&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Reduce the credit burden by repaying the outstanding liabilities&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Avoid submitting new loan applications frequently since credit history inquiries (other than for loan monitoring purposes) may negatively affect the customer’s Credit Score.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Detailed information about the credit history (including wrong or incomplete information) and/or Credit Score is available on the following pages:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://acra.am/%D5%AF%D5%A1%D5%BA-%D6%87-%D5%A1%D5%BB%D5%A1%D5%AF%D6%81%D5%B8%D6%82%D5%A9%D5%B5%D5%B8%D6%82%D5%B6/%D5%B0-%D5%BF-%D5%B0/?lang=en&quot;&gt;acra.am&lt;/a&gt; –Support– Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://abcfinance.am/news/credit-history.html&quot;&gt;abcfinance.am&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://abcfinance.am/news/news_varkayinscore.html&quot;&gt;abcfinance.am&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;INFORMATION ON FACTORS ABOUT CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;This document sets out the information required under the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations about the credit history and the credit score of customers during lending in Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter “the Bank”) and the factors affecting them.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit History&lt;/strong&gt; is the information on the customer’s financial obligations generated/processed by the Credit Bureau, which shows the customer’s debt, payments, payment habits or other data related to the customer’s obligations or their performance and the dynamics/history of such information.&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The credit history includes, in particular, the information required for customer identification, amount of each monetary obligation of the customer, annual interest rate, outstanding liabilities, order and terms of payments, payment delays, guarantees issued to the third parties, information about the liabilities of the parties affiliated with the customer (in depersonalized form) and the information about credit history inquiries.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;As a rule, financial organizations use the credit history to assess the customer’s monetary (credit) obligations, guarantees issued to the third parties, to consider the possibilities of lending at the customer’s or bank’s initiative and to submit lending offers to the customer.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Based on the customer’s consent the Bank sends an inquiry to ACRA Credit Bureau. The information about the credit history is reflected in the credit report which covers the customer’s credit history for the most recent 5 years.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The Customer’s credit history is available at &lt;a href=&quot;http://www.acra.am/&quot;&gt;http://www.acra.am/&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit score&lt;/strong&gt; is the quantified measure of the customer’s borrowing capacity and creditworthiness.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The Bank uses its own system to assess the borrowing capacity and creditworthiness for lending to customers. The factors affecting it are as follows:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit history&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;․ &lt;/strong&gt;The quantity and amount of existing loans, frequency of applying for loans, positive credit history (no payment delays in the credit history, high quality of loan service) can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending, while a bad credit history (payment delays in the credit history, persistent nature of such delays) can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score, rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Employment, income and work experience&lt;/strong&gt;. Stable job and income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending. Unstable or non-permanent job or income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Credit burden.&lt;/strong&gt;High credit burden and its big share in the income can serve as a basis for reducing the credit score and rejecting a new loan application or reviewing it on more stringent terms, while a low credit burden and its small share in the income can help improve the credit score and make a positive decision on lending&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;FICO Score. FICO Score&lt;/strong&gt; is a scoring system that provides a numerical value of credit risk through statistic research and analysis of the customer’s credit history. It is a key used by lenders worldwide to assess creditworthiness and financial risks. Details are available at &lt;a href=&quot;https://acra.am/սքոր/&quot;&gt;acra.am&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Other information about the Customer &lt;/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The importance of credit history and credit score&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Credit history and credit score are essential for making a decision on lending, enabling banks and credit organizations to assess the credit risk of the customer during lending and predict the customer’s proper fulfillment of customer’s monetary obligations and its likelihood.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wrong or incomplete credit history &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;If there are wrong or incomplete data in the credit history, the customer can apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or directly to the financial organizations having provided the information to the Credit Bureau to correct or clarify such data.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The procedure and details on applying to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC is available at www.&lt;a href=&quot;https://acra.am/կապ-և-աջակցություն/հաճախորդի-իրավունքներ/&quot;&gt;acra.am&lt;/a&gt; &amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Where wrong or incomplete information has been provided to the Credit Bureau by the Bank, the customer can apply to the Bank via any of the following channels:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By sending an application to the Bank’s official email address&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111 phone numbers&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By sending a message via the Bank’s Online/Mobile Banking system&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;By submitting an application at any of the Bank’s branches.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;The Bank will process the customer’s application in the manner and within the time frames defined by the Republic of Armenia laws and regulations, and/or the Bank’s internal regulations.&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How to improve the credit history and credit score&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;To improve the credit history and credit score it is necessary to eliminate its root causes as soon as possible, in particular:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Make loan payments in accordance with the defined schedule, excluding any late payments and even 1-day overdue liabilities&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Limit the number and amount of provided guarantees, by repaying the overdue liabilities secured by guarantees, if possible&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Reduce the credit burden by repaying the outstanding liabilities&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;Avoid submitting new loan applications frequently since credit history inquiries (other than for loan monitoring purposes) may negatively affect the customer’s Credit Score.&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;p&gt;Detailed information about the credit history (including wrong or incomplete information) and/or Credit Score is available on the following pages:&lt;/p&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://acra.am/%D5%AF%D5%A1%D5%BA-%D6%87-%D5%A1%D5%BB%D5%A1%D5%AF%D6%81%D5%B8%D6%82%D5%A9%D5%B5%D5%B8%D6%82%D5%B6/%D5%B0-%D5%BF-%D5%B0/?lang=en&quot;&gt;acra.am&lt;/a&gt; –Support– Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://abcfinance.am/news/credit-history.html&quot;&gt;abcfinance.am&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://abcfinance.am/news/news_varkayinscore.html&quot;&gt;abcfinance.am&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;/ul&gt;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>h3</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&quot;&quot;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&quot;&quot;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&quot;&quot;</del></span>

<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Personal/Loans/mortgage_personal_purchase_eng.pdf&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Terms of the loan for purchase of residential real estate from primary market&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Personal/Loans/mortgage_personal_express_eng.pdf&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Terms of express Home Mortgage Loan (Purchase, Construction and Renovation)&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Personal/Loans/terms_flexible_mortgage_eng.pdf&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Mortgage lending terms and conditions for purchase of residential real estate at the primary market with flexible opportunities offered by development companies cooperating with Ameriabank CJSC&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Personal/Loans/terms_mortgage_lending_campaign_eng.pdf&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Terms of residential and commercial real estate mortgage lending (including refinancing) campaign&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https://ameriabank.am/Portals/0/files/Personal/Loans/Loan_tariffs_eng.pdf&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Loan service fees&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;http://www.abcfinance.am/&quot;&gt;“Finance for All” abcfinance.am website&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</del></span>  
<span style="background:#ffe6e6;color:#b42318;padding:0.08em 0.18em;"><del>&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;http://www.fininfo.am/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Your financial database www.fininfo.am&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;ATTENTION! “YOUR FINANCIAL DATABASE” IS AN ELECTRONIC SYSTEM AIMED AT FACILITATING SEARCHING AND COMPARISON OF THE SERVICES OFFERED TO INDIVIDUALS AND MAKING THE CHOICE EASIER FOR YOU.&lt;br&gt;&lt;ul&gt;</del></span>
